# Trovina

> Trovina (trovina.io) is a software and digital product studio that designs and builds websites, web apps, mobile apps and AI automation for startups and growing businesses. Projects are fixed-price, run in weekly sprints with live demos, and include support after launch. The studio is based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria, and works with clients remotely worldwide.

Key facts:
- Services: website and web app development, mobile apps (iOS/Android), AI and WhatsApp automation, cloud and DevOps, SEO, branding, graphic design, video editing.
- Starting prices: websites from ₦450,000 (US$750); web apps and online stores from ₦1,800,000 (US$2,800); web + mobile products from ₦4,500,000 (US$7,500); monthly care plans from ₦150,000 (US$250).
- Typical timelines: websites 2–3 weeks; web apps 6–10 weeks; full products 10–16 weeks.
- Industries: real estate, schools and institutions, e-commerce and supermarkets, healthcare, logistics and transport, fintech and cooperatives, oil, gas and energy, hospitality.
- Recent work: a multi-tenant hospital ERP (SaaS), a white-label HR management system, and a fleet tracking system with web admin and driver mobile app.
- Clients own all code, designs and accounts at hand-over.
- Company: Trovina Technologies Limited.
- Contact: hello@trovina.io, +234 903 724 8511 (phone and WhatsApp), Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00 WAT.

## Services

- [Websites & web apps](https://trovina.io/services/web-app-website-development): React and Next.js websites, online stores, portals and SaaS
- [Mobile apps](https://trovina.io/services/mobile-app-development): Flutter, React Native, Swift and Kotlin apps
- [AI automation](https://trovina.io/services/ai-automation-workflow-systems): WhatsApp assistants, lead follow-up and workflow automation
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://trovina.io/services/cloud-infrastructure-devops): AWS, Google Cloud and Azure hosting, CI/CD, monitoring
- [SEO & growth](https://trovina.io/services/seo-growth-optimization): Technical SEO, content and conversion optimisation
- [Branding & identity](https://trovina.io/services/branding-visual-identity): Logos, visual identity and brand guidelines
- [Graphics & creative](https://trovina.io/services/graphics-creative-design): Social, ad and marketing design
- [Video & motion](https://trovina.io/services/video-editing-motion-content): Video editing, reels and motion graphics
